name: Hsisosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in a shartegosuchid/shartegosuchoid group that has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Hsisosuchus is a crocodyliform from the Middle to Late Jurassic of China, likely a medium-sized predator about 3 m long.
wsnote: About 3 m long, an estimate (English Wikipedia).
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Specimens of three species (H. dashanpuensis, H. chungkingensis, H. chowi) from the Shaximiao Formation and other Chinese units.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Young and Chow 1953
